findings.title: نازحو مواصي خان يونس في مواجهة منخفض جوي جديد بلا مقومات إيواء
findings.publisher: WAFA Palestinian News and Information Agency
findings.location: Al-Mawasi, Khan Younis, southern Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: Displaced households and shelter aid delivery. New on-the-ground reporting by Tariq al-Astal documents four named displaced residents describing unresolved damage from earlier rain and unmet shelter needs. One reports receiving no shelter aid despite being listed as affected; another reports loss of stored food and uneven aid distribution; another says he borrowed money to replace a destroyed tent. This is localized evidence of outstanding aid gaps, not a confirmed new storm, new displacement count, or Gaza-wide aid assessment.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: لم يتلقَّ حتى الآن أي مساعدة أو تدخل من الجهات المعنية لتوفير مستلزمات الإيواء
findings.source_type: Established news agency, firsthand interviews with named displaced residents

bounded_discovery_context.method: Direct Arabic WAFA front page and full report; publication timestamp 11:14 Gaza local, corresponding to 01:14 PST, within window.
bounded_discovery_context.novelty: New site-specific testimony of persistent unmet shelter and food needs adds concrete household-level evidence beyond prior general storm warning; six authenticated preceding heartbeat files reviewed.
bounded_discovery_context.caveat: Individual testimony not independently corroborated. No newly verified flood damage, casualty count, or overall change in aid volumes. Exact interview date and local publication offset not independently verified (offset inferred).
